rules.retryGuard: Do not repeat the same failed investigation more than twice without new evidence.

B1_COVERAGE_EVSE_MATRIX.description: Direct/ad-hoc prices are observed at station/EVSE level, but estate coverage or an authoritative complete EVSE-to-tariff matrix is missing.
B1_COVERAGE_EVSE_MATRIX.nextAction: Batch CPO-to-station-to-EVSE reconciliation using Mobilithek/AFIR/DATEX II and the identified backend; certify only fully covered tariff classes.

B2_FIRST_PARTY_ADHOC_EQUIVALENCE.description: The operator/network and some prices are known, but a current first-party anonymous/ad-hoc matrix or proof of equivalence is missing.
B2_FIRST_PARTY_ADHOC_EQUIVALENCE.nextAction: Search current first-party tariff sheets, QR/direct-payment checkout and authoritative AFIR/EVSE price records; keep card/contract pricing separate.

B3_SITE_CONFIGURABLE_BACKEND.description: The backend/operator explicitly supports owner/site/charge-point-specific pricing, so no network-wide tariff can be inferred.
B3_SITE_CONFIGURABLE_BACKEND.nextAction: Extract public per-EVSE prices from the shared backend/AFIR surface in bulk and retain station-scoped tariffs.

B4_FEE_COMPONENT_COMPLETENESS.description: The energy price is known on sampled EVSEs but one or more session/time/blocking/grace/payment components are not fully proven.
B4_FEE_COMPONENT_COMPLETENESS.nextAction: Audit complete binding price offers/checkout terms per EVSE, including time and blocking fees before promoting to complete.

B5_OPERATOR_IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION.description: Brand, physical CPO, backend operator, duplicate sites or feed ownership are not sufficiently reconciled.
B5_OPERATOR_IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION.nextAction: Resolve physical operator and aliases first, then attach station/EVSE tariffs to the canonical CPO without double counting.

B6_DYNAMIC_SURFACE_OR_APP.description: The authoritative tariff exists behind a dynamic widget/app/backend surface but the numeric anonymous values were not exposed in the accessible first pass.
B6_DYNAMIC_SURFACE_OR_APP.nextAction: Inspect the public/guest dynamic endpoint or app backend without bypassing authentication/security; otherwise retain fail-closed.

nextSafeAction: Continue classification over the remaining 362 partial CPOs from the historical checkpoint chain, then execute the B1/B2/B4 high-resolvability batches before configurable-backend and identity long-tail work.
